entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to start a return for an item I bought recently.
I can certainly help with that. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series cycling jersey. It looks like it was delivered about 14 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's simply the wrong size. I ordered a medium, but it's just too tight across the chest. I'd like to send it back.

I understand. One moment while I check our policy... Okay, yes, not a problem at all. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can process that for you right now. Would you prefer a full refund or an exchange for a larger size?

An exchange would be perfect. I'd like to try a large. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of packaging this up and sending it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase?

I'm happy to get that exchange set up for the correct size. While I can't offer a discount code for a standard size exchange, I can confirm that we cover the return shipping costs. I'm generating the prepaid return label for you now. It should be in your email in the next few minutes.
Alright, I understand. As long as the return shipping is covered, that's fair. So the new jersey will ship out once you receive this one?
That's correct. Once our warehouse scans your return, the new size will be dispatched immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
